display.purpose: Home thesis and the largest page openings.

title.purpose: Planner name, policy title, and primary page headings.

deck.purpose: Song Myung decks, interview introductions, summaries, and the policy lede.

label.purpose: Folios, issue metadata, and panel labels; never a kicker above a heading.

reading.purpose: The policy article and other long-form reading pages.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The only shadow; modal sheets that protect a task.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on controls; reduced-motion collapses to instant.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that starts or completes a task.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 600 14px/1.2 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ink-soft); border-color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Adjacent actions, export, and row-level choices.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 600 14px/1.2 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-paper-raised); color: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-faint); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-paper-deep); }

components.name: Field
components.description: A quiet paper input with a visible boundary and a 44px target.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 400 15px/1.6 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font: 600 12px/1.3 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-faint); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-paper-raised); color: var(--color-ink); font: inherit; caret-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Error Notice
components.description: A full-bordered tinted notice; no side stripe.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-c) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-c-soft) 50%, transparent); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 14px/1.6 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; }

components.name: Timeline Bar
components.description: The data mark for one activity on the five-year chronology.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-left: 3px solid var(--color-work); border-radius: 1px; background: var(--color-work-soft); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 11px/1.35 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-bar-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-work); flex: none; } .ds-bar-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-bar-body strong { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-bar-body span { font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

components.name: Rating Meter
components.description: One self-rating axis as a quiet data cell.
components.css: .ds-rating { padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-paper-raised); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 12px/1.4 "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-rating-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-rating-head strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-rating-track { height: 3px; margin-top: 8px; background: var(--color-paper-deep); } .ds-rating-track span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--color-ink); }

narrative.overview: Ople reads as a quarterly of possible lives, not a productivity dashboard. The page is a spread: warm paper, ink, an asymmetric editorial grid, and a chronology that behaves like the feature well of a cultural magazine. The product's three futures and its five-year timeline are the content and the ornament; no scene, photograph, or mascot is needed to carry the world. The system is quiet by construction: large Korean grotesque headlines do the announcing; Song Myung carries the decks, pull quotes, and the policy article's reading voice; hairline rules, folio metadata, and small data marks do the separating. A/B/C are a fixed color grammar, never a decorative accent. The app keeps standard web controls so the private work of editing a life stays legible.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with archive ink; flat surfaces and hairline rules.
A 12-column asymmetric grid with a 7/5 hero, 4/8 feature, 5/7 method, and 1.7/1 planner spread.
Pretendard for display and interface; Song Myung for decks, pull quotes, and the policy body.
Three plan roles: olive A, cobalt B, persimmon C; a separate category data palette for work, creative, relation, and rest.
The five-year chronology is the signature component and the main visual proof.

rules.name: The Three Futures Rule
rules.body: Olive, cobalt, and persimmon identify A, B, and C. They do not become generic decoration, gradients, or page backgrounds.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The ground is warm paper. No literal scene, photographic hero, gradient text, glass, or soft chrome stands in for the editorial material.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Pretendard carries navigation, headlines, controls, and working copy. Song Myung carries decks, pull quotes, and the policy article. Never set the main headline in the serif.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: A heading carries its own weight. Do not add a small uppercase eyebrow above a heading; keep labels for folios, panels, lists, and navigation.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation appears only when a modal protects a task; a card shadow never substitutes for a hairline.

dos: Do use the warm paper ground, archive ink, and 1px rules to carry structure.
Do keep olive A, cobalt B, and persimmon C for plan identity and data, not decoration.
Do set decks, pull quotes, and the policy body in Song Myung; keep headlines and controls in Pretendard.
Do make the five-year chronology the hero and use the activity index to make short bars readable.
Do label example data as example and keep the app's real controls standard.
Do preserve 44px targets, visible focus, the sticky-header scroll offset, and the reduced-motion reset.
donts: Don't add a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't introduce literal scenes, photography, gradients, glass, or chrome as a stand-in for the editorial material.
Don't use cards, nested cards, hard offset shadows, or one-sided side stripes on boxes.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji as an icon system; use the drawn icons.
Don't push display tracking past -0.04em or set the main headline in the serif.
Don't use monospace for labels that are not measurement or data.
